TITLE: Frontend Developer
HERO_SUBLINE: Driven by a deep dedication to detail, I craft refined user interfaces—and self-host this portfolio and every live project on my own server.
NAME: Dennis Schwarz
ABOUT_HEADLINE: Distilling complex technical challenges into calm, refined digital experiences.
ABOUT_ME_INFO: Hi, I'm Dennis Schwarz—a German-speaking Frontend Developer based in Neunkirchen (Saarland). Driven by the possibilities of modern web engineering, I craft visually compelling, performant, and intuitive web applications.
LOCATION: Adaptable across working environments: I collaborate seamlessly both on-site in Saarland and remotely with distributed teams.
COQNITION: Analytical, open-minded, and continuously seeking demanding engineering challenges to sharpen my architectural and UI skills.
QUALITY: To me, software development goes far beyond writing code—it is structured, creative problem-solving that turns ambitious product visions into maintainable, user-centric applications.
EXPLORE: A curated selection of my applications—each deployed as an isolated container on my own infrastructure and ready to explore live.
PROJECT_JOIN: Kanban-inspired task management application. Create, prioritize, and organize workflows via fluid drag-and-drop interactions, user assignments, and custom categories.
PROJECT_SHARKIE: Dynamic 2D action platformer built on clean object-oriented JavaScript architecture featuring frame-accurate collision detection, sprite animations, and enemy AI.
PROJECT_DA_BUBBLE: Scalable real-time team messenger and project collaboration workspace engineered with Angular, TypeScript, and Firebase with channels, threads, and direct messaging.
JOURNEY: Across my projects, I pair modern Angular and TypeScript architectures with responsive design systems and reproducible deployments—continuously evolving my toolkit to stay ahead in modern web engineering.
SKILL_SET_CONTACT_ME: Feel free to reach out—I quickly adapt to new frameworks, design systems, and architectural patterns.
SERVER_INFO: Beyond pure frontend development, I operate this portfolio and every live project independently on a dedicated Debian 12 VPS. Every application ships via multi-stage Docker builds and is routed to isolated subdomains (*.dennis-schwarz.dev) through a declarative Traefik v3 reverse proxy with automated Let’s Encrypt TLS 1.3 encryption—complemented by a hardened Node.js mail microservice for direct, GDPR-compliant communication.
